note:
P3M: the weight sync method comparison, run so the difference can actually be attributed.

The first pass at this (cells p3d_*) measured colocated at mem-fraction 0.8 and disaggregated at
0.85, because colocated has to leave room for the trainer on the same device. That difference is
not innocent: the colocated path calls flush_cache() on every sync
(update_weight_from_tensor.py:215) and the cost of dropping a KV pool scales with the pool, while
the distributed path never flushes at all. So a 0.05 gap in mem-fraction lands INSIDE the quantity
being compared. These cells hold mem-fraction at 0.8 for BOTH methods, which is the value colocated
already used, so the colocated arm stays comparable to the existing h200_p3_colo_* numbers and the
disaggregated arm gives up a little KV headroom rather than the comparison giving up its meaning.

Second change: NUM_ROLLOUT 3 -> 7. The B300 measurement observed steady state only from the 4th
sync onward, so claiming 'steady' from a 3-rollout run (2 post-warmup samples) contradicts our own
prior evidence. 7 rollouts give 4 samples after discarding the first 3.

What this matrix can and cannot settle: it isolates the method axis on H200/miles at fixed
mem-fraction and TP. It does NOT separate framework (miles vs slime) -- that needs the slime arm,
and the existing slime numbers came from a different cluster on a different day with no surviving
launch log, so they cannot carry that claim.

cells.name: colo_tp1_mf08
cells.note:
colocated, TP1, mem-fraction 0.8, 7 rollouts. Re-measures the existing
h200_p3_colo_tp1 (0.40s from 3 rollouts) with enough samples to call it steady, and becomes the
reference the disaggregated arm is differenced against.

cells.name: disagg_tp1_mf08
cells.note:
disaggregated, TP1, mem-fraction 0.8 (NOT 0.85), 7 rollouts. Differs from the cell
above in the placement and nothing else, which is the whole point.

cells.name: disagg_tp1_mf085
cells.note:
disaggregated, TP1, mem-fraction 0.85. Exists only to measure how much
mem-fraction moves the number at all. If the 0.8 vs 0.85 gap is small next to the method gap, the
earlier p3d_* cells are salvageable rather than confounded beyond use; if it is comparable, they
are not, and saying so is the point of running this.
